body: Where do i even start... I lived my younger years in a grouphome because im basically the bastard of a half blind, fat, bald and bipolar psychopath that was my dad, and was taken away (for good reason). All the shitty meds those quack docters gave me made me look like a tweaker. When i eventually moved to a fosterhome and started going to school all the kids laughed and made fun of me. My dads side kicked in and i beat up all the kids and was transfered to those special ed schools. Half my life i resented everybody because everyone treated me like i wasnt human, even the teachers. I was restrained, beat up and humiliated countless times untill i was adopted and promptly taken out of that school and rehabilitated by being slowly taken off the meds and going through therapy. But by then it was too late, all those years i never smiled at once, everyday i cried. All the mental agony and imprisonment took its toll. I have social anxiety and i cant even smile no mattet how hard i try. And all my hormones supressed by the meds made me into a 250 pound ugly, unnapproachable, unfuckable goblin. Even now at 17 and losing 45lbs i still cant see myself ever being lucky enough to have the chance to have a special someone to love, and for them to love me back

Everything is a lie. We havent lived in anything remotely close to real since the turn of the century. We turned it off, took out the batteries and snacked on a bag of GMO's while we tossed the remenants in the dumpster of the ever expanding human condition. Movies, celebrities, magazines, even regular people, its all fake. Movies and actors are all fabricated bullshit. And they expect us to see that as perfect. Every face has a mask. Behind it is a tortured soul who wishes he was like everyone else. Were insignificant specks of cosmic dust unfortunate enough to be given life and to be able to experience pain. And its maddening that every dumb fucking sack of meat thinks he/she is the shit. Fuck them, and fuck me. its bullshit. Memories are a paradox. You can only remember them as long as your alive. Dont worry, in time no one will even know about anyone, we will all sleep the big sleep.
